what_was_blocked_last_round: the learned trajectory could not be reused on a new goal: an empty text field has almost no appearance, and a 40x40 patch of the blank input matched 453 offsets spread over 258 pixels

the_change.principle: DECIDING stays with vision. ADDRESSING moves to the page's own tree.
the_change.why_the_ban_was_half_wrong: the visual executor forbids DOM. and Accessibility. so the agent cannot be steered by the thing it is operating on. That is right for DECIDING and wrong for ADDRESSING, where there is no judgement, only geometry.
the_change.enforcement: ALLOWED_ADDRESSING is an allowlist of read-only methods; anything else raises AddressingError rather than being filtered
the_change.what_it_may_never_do: navigate, capture, input, evaluate, or read values

measured.teach_once: click textbox/filter, type {slot0}, click button/APPLY  -- the model decided this, once
measured.reuse_1: goal 'show only the messages about refund' -> typed 'refund' -> heading reads 'Inbox - 1 shown', one matching message
measured.reuse_2: goal 'show only messages from alice' -> typed 'alice'
measured.reuse_3: goal 'show only the urgent messages' -> typed 'urgent' -> heading reads 'Inbox - 3 shown'

robustness.result: 4/4 addressed and run with zero model calls; the coordinate changed every time and the skill never stored one

hostile_checks: a forbidden CDP call raises rather than being filtered
a missing target stops the run before any action
an unfillable goal is refused, not guessed
the addresser's source contains no notion of a goal, an intention or a choice

what_this_actually_is.yes: a demonstration recorded once, reused with new parameters on four differently laid-out pages, with no model in the reuse path
what_this_actually_is.no: not a solution to any computer use. It works where the page is built from standard roles and accessible names. A canvas, a custom-drawn widget, or an unlabelled div gives it nothing to address, and it would refuse.
what_this_actually_is.the_honest_boundary: structure addressing works when the interface has structure. Vision remains necessary for everything that does not.

the_three-signal_division_that_finally_h.model: decides what to do, by looking -- once, at teach time
the_three-signal_division_that_finally_h.page: reports where things are, by structure -- every time, exactly
the_three-signal_division_that_finally_h.gate: checks what happened, by pixels -- every step, causally

what_this_does_not_prove: no public benchmark number: still zero
